name: immutableqc
description: Check lab input files against sealed instrument files, and record AI agent steps in a local ledger.
long_description: Tamper-evident records for automated research labs. check_inputs says whether each file's exact bytes were sealed by an instrument station (measured), written by a recorded step (derived), or neither (untraced). record_step appends a signed record of what the agent read, wrote and did. trace follows a file back to sealed files; audit_summary checks every ledger under the lab folder. Nothing is uploaded; the server never uses the network.

tools.name: check_inputs
tools.description: Whether each file was measured, derived or untraced; reads only.

tools.name: record_step
tools.description: Appends a signed record of one step: inputs, outputs, action.

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Traces a file back to sealed files; reads only.

tools.name: audit_summary
tools.description: Pass, review or fail for every ledger under the lab folder; reads only.

workspace.title: Agent workspace
workspace.description: The folder the agent reads and writes in. Every path a tool takes must be inside it.

lab_folder.title: Lab data folder
lab_folder.description: The folder that holds the instruments' sealed folders (searched for ledgers). It can be the workspace or a folder above it.
